title: Spend this day on profit that remains
summary: The real profit of human life is meeting, service, and return. Use this day for what can still remain.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: When aimlessness starts thinning the day, let one concrete act answer the question of why you were given this body.

source.shortMeaning: The real profit of human life is meeting, service, and return.
source.lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity.

evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: pause the deal and choose the profit that can follow you.
